title: Yearly review of the personnel services director
summary: In late 2024 the Civil Service Commission was writing questions for the yearly review of the personnel services director, due in March, and a commissioner suggested input from department leaders. In October 2026 the discussion of the director's evaluation timetable was deferred until a new director is selected.

timeline.text: Old business item 5B: performance evaluation timetable and procedure for the director of personnel services: The discussion of the director's performance evaluation timetable was deferred until a new director is selected.
The review was described as due at the end of the first quarter of the calendar year, in March.
The review questions will go to staff to share with department directors and Personnel Services employees.
Questions for the yearly review of the personnel services director are being written.
A commissioner suggested also getting input from about three department leaders.
